title: Your dishwasher is better than you think (tips, tricks, and how they work)
summary: Technology Connections explains how dishwashers work and how to use them well, including detergent use, the prewash cycle and why pre-rinsing hurts. It follows his earlier dishwasher videos.
why: HN people recommend it as the definitive, thorough guide to getting dishwashers to clean properly and often send it to friends.

quote.text: I’ve sent dozens of people the Technology Connections video on this topic to rave reviews
